dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Uniform and rapid 2D width reduction from the widest thoracic point toward a sharply acute posterior termination.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Symmetrical, smooth lateral margins with minor concave disruptions at the anterior-lateral pectoral junctions.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Light grey to off-white median pixel intensity; significant shadow-based darkening along the lateral edges.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Low-frequency, diffuse grey shading concentrated along the longitudinal dorsal midline and posterior region.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse; gradual gradient transitions between the light dorsal field and darker lateral shading.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Highly localized dark circular point (blowhole) at the anterior; clusters of small dark punctate marks on both lateral flanks.
high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.dorsal_surface_indentations: Defined, continuous narrow longitudinal ridge along the central axis; no macro-scale topological depressions visible.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Multiple small, dark-pixel clusters and short linear marks visible on the mid-lateral margins, particularly on the viewer's left.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced needle-like geometric sharpening of the posterior peduncle.
